Bio:
Also a varsity basketball player. Grew up running track.

2020: MaxPreps Preseason All-American second-team pick. MaxPreps All-Florida first-team selection. Helped the Panthers reach semifinals of 8A state playoffs. Missed some games due to injury. Two-way contributor doubling as a wide receiver.

2019: Miami Herald All-Dade 8A-6A first-team selection as a junior. A key part of Palmetto's 10-2 season which included a deep run in the 8A state playoffs as he made plays on both offense and defense.
ScoutEvaluation: Has the looks of a new-age cornerback given his length. Some muscle has already developed in the upper body, but no where near close to being maxed out. A natural athlete with a bounce to his step which likely stems from his basketball background. Tracks the ball extremely well and doesn’t seem to have a problem flipping his hips while running in coverage. Excels on defense, but also makes an impact on offense and can score via the return game. Is physical at times, but hasn’t been asked to press much in high school. Plays fast for his size, but top-end speed a question mark. Should develop into a multi-year starter at the Power 5 level and projects as a potential Day 2 draft pick.
